name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Buzz relay for a workspace where people and AI agents share channels, threads, DMs, media and git events, with PostgreSQL, Redis and S3 storage.

alerts.message: The relay starts open: any Nostr key can join. To make it members-only, set RELAY_OWNER_PUBKEY to your 64-character hex public key (Buzz Desktop: Settings - Identity - Public key) and BUZZ_REQUIRE_RELAY_MEMBERSHIP to true, then redeploy.
There is no browser client: connect with the Buzz desktop or mobile app using wss://<your-domain>. The community is keyed to RELAY_URL, so deploy on the final domain before adding data.
